en.topic_title: China says solar power capacity surpasses coal for first time

zh.topic_title: China says solar power capacity surpasses coal for first time

en.topic_title: China says solar power capacity surpasses coal for first time
en.topic_summary:
China’s installed solar energy capacity has surpassed that of coal-fired power for the first time, the national energy body said Tuesday, hailing the milestone.



Installation of solar photovoltaic panels on the roofs of the Hongqiao Passenger Rail Terminal in Shanghai, China, in 2010. Photo: Climate Group, via Flickr. 



China, the world’s largest emitter of greenhouse gases that drive climate change, has pledged to peak carbon emissions by 2030 and achieve carbon neutrality by 20
